{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("\nDistribution of customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if 'loyal' exists in customer_segment
has_loyal = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"\nIs 'loyal' present in customer_segment? {has_loyal}")

# Check the 'converted' column
print("\nDistribution of converted:")
print(df['converted'].value_counts())"}
